title: Planning Children’s Party Food: Ages, Portions and Timing
body_markdown:
Children’s party food should fit their ages, activity schedule and serving arrangements. Separate children’s portions from adult food and collect dietary information before the menu is agreed.

For the service options, explore [event catering in Dubai](/events). Use this guide to prepare the details for your enquiry.

## About this guide

This guide is published by myCHEF, a provider of private chef and catering services. It compares service formats and practical selection criteria. Individual providers should be assessed through their current proposals, relevant documentation and suitability for your occasion.

## Plan separate food needs

Tell the caterer how many children and adults will attend and the children’s age range. Easy-to-serve favourites, fruit and a few options for adults may work better than one menu for every guest. Confirm portion sizes and when the main food will be available.

## Coordinate with the party schedule

Agree the timing of food, activities and the cake. Keep service areas separate from active play, and confirm who manages the table and clearing. Any live cooking equipment needs an appropriate position and supervision.

## Collect dietary information early

Ask parents for relevant allergies and requirements before confirming the menu. The culinary provider should explain ingredient checks, labelling and any cross-contact limitations. Confirm the cake, desserts and purchased components as carefully as the main dishes.

## Questions to ask before confirming

Request a written menu and scope, confirm the guest count and service hours, and check which staff, equipment and extras are included. Share dietary requirements before approving the menu. Review the payment schedule, change deadlines and cancellation terms, and identify the contact who will coordinate the booking.

## Use your completed brief

If children’s birthday catering suits your plans, explore the service details and published options below. Share your date, Dubai location, guest count and preferences so the team can assess availability and prepare a tailored proposal. The written booking confirms the final menu, responsibilities and price.
